Checked-in copy of payzeno-api's generated OpenAPI document. Written only by `scripts/pull-openapi.mjs` (`pnpm openapi:pull`), which CI runs on every PR so a route rename lands as a reviewable diff. `src/api/contract/routes.contract.test.ts` asserts that every path the endpoint classes build appears here — that assertion is the console's only compile-time-adjacent guard against payzeno-api moving a route.

Do not hand-edit.
